summary: Markets are risk-off and highly event-driven, with concerns over the Binance hack, AI-spending sustainability, midterm elections, and potential US-Iran diplomacy dominating sentiment. Bitcoin is steady but vulnerable, while ether is modestly firmer; gold is rebounding from a one-year low as oil prices collapse and ease inflation concerns.[3][8]
